question: Order flow on the practice account (Sim, no real money): yes = text /oflane on in Telegram
why: The order-flow bot fades a sweep of yesterday's / overnight / opening-range high or low only when the sweep bar was absorbed. On 53 real tick days (Sep 27 - Nov 26) it took 40 trades: 50% won, +0.49R a trade, +$1,582 at 1 micro (skipped ones: -0.31R; shuffle p 0.0065). Honest catch: the older half was much better than the newer half (+1.40R vs +0.11R gap), it is one 2-month market, and 0 forward days have been scored yet. At the lane's $200 risk a trade it would have sent 30 of the 40 (+$2,513, worst drawdown -$950, 3.5 trades a week; old fill model - the new limit-at-the-level entry kept +0.54R in the fill study).
impact: Practice money only: it shows whether the real order path (limit at the level, stop, 2R target, 15:55 close) gets the fills the paper bot assumes. Those Sim fills are what the next step (one small eval test) waits for.
applies: YES = text /oflane on (or on the PC: python -X utf8 -m engine.of_lane --sim on). It starts by itself at 09:20 ET on weekdays on Sim102, or on Sim101 when Sim102 does not exist and nothing else uses Sim101 (the reply says which). /oflane off stops new trades. Real / MFFU accounts are refused in three places and never touched.
risk: No real money (simulation account). It can never trade an eval or funded account: that needs the forward gate plus your separate yes and the live phrase.
recommend_why: It costs nothing, the stop rules and kill switch apply, and the forward ladder needs real-order-path fills before any eval is even asked.
